messages:
kevin: FYI proposal for tiered routing + variant fallback UX. Idea: per-customer-tier policy that declares allowed model variants, soft quota windows, and a fallback chain. Wants console to show 'risk score' and allow per-tenant overrides. Pasting minimal example.

maria: can we ensure billing events map to variant choice? need per-token rate multipliers. Also need telemetry keys: route.name, variant, fallback_reason.

kevin: yes. example policy:
```json
{
  "tier": "pro",
  "routes": [
    {"priority": 1, "variant": "redwood-13b-quant", "max_qps": 50},
    {"priority": 2, "variant": "redwood-7b-quant", "max_qps": 200, "soft_quota_window_s": 120}
  ],
  "fallback_policy": {"on_quota": "degrade", "on_error": "retry_next"},
  "telemetry_tags": ["route.name","variant","fallback_reason"]
}
```

jamie: in console UX do we let admins drag-to-reorder variants or force explicit priority numbers? drag is nicer but tricky for synonyms.

kevin: prefer explicit priority + small drag affordance that updates priority numbers. also suggest a 'simulate' button to run workload samples and show expected % routed per variant.

anar: enforcement question — do we enforce quotas at edge proxy or at routing layer? proxy enforcement helps stop bad clients, but routing-layer has more model-awareness. leaning router + distributed counters + eventual strong guard at proxy.

maria: +1 on router enforcement; can we expose a per-tenant telemetry stream for alerts when fallback_rate > 5% for 5m?

kevin: yep, add alert: `fallback_rate > 0.05 for 5m` and page on enterprise only. also add circuit-breaker to avoid cascading failures.

deploy-bot: deploy started for branch feature/tier-routing (build 2356) :rocket:

kevin: I'll write up spec doc and link a simple API draft. tagging @jamie @anar for UX/ops review :wave:
